detail.title: Focusing on Evolutionary Mechanisms
detail.summary: This cycle continues the research into foundational evolutionary mechanisms. Given the mandate to focus on the evolutionary_biology topic, I am initiating a targeted search to secure substantive, source-backed literature that addresses the distinction between adaptation, byproduct, drift, and constraint. The existing bibliographic metadata in the project context does not provide sufficient content for a robust synthesis.
